items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Joe Turner was an influence in my life... He was a real buddy when I was young. He was very encouraging.

ctx.x: Now, when Adelaide Hall came to the Lafayette from England and (?), they had two piano players. I think it was Joe Turner or Francis Carter, I don't know who it was... Because Joe at that time used to wear a derby hat, when he came from Europe... Boy, he was a natty...! I heard about this piano player. Everybody talked about this piano player that played... She had two pianos on the stage. I didn't see the (?). But they talked about him. "What's his name?" "Art Tatum." Well, I thought that was a funny name.
